in_sanskrit.name: धरुव
in_sanskrit.meaning: धृत् पद् - fixed, established, steadfast or immovable
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धृत् (dhrit) - that which is held, established, firm, steady, fixed, unchangeable. पद् (pad) - foot, step, base, foundation. Therefore, Dhrupad means 'that which is fixed or established at the base or foundation'. This is the origin of the name in Sanskrit.

in_hindi.name: धरुपद
in_hindi.meaning: धृत् पाद - fixed, established, steadfast or immovable
in_hindi.long_meaning: धृत् (dhrit) - that which is held, established, firm, steady, fixed, unchangeable. पाद (pad) - foot. Therefore, Dhrupad in Hindi also means 'that which is fixed or established at the base or foundation'. This is the origin of the name in Hindi.

in_tamil.name: திருப்பத
in_tamil.meaning: திரு (thiru) - sacred, divine, holy. பதம் (patham) - base, foundation. Therefore, Dhrupad in Tamil also means 'sacred or divine base or foundation'. This is the origin of the name in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: ధరుపద్
in_telugu.meaning: ధృత్ పద్ - fixed, established, steadfast or immovable
in_telugu.long_meaning: ధృత్ (dhrit) - that which is held, established, firm, steady, fixed, unchangeable. పద్ (pad) - foot, step, base, foundation. Therefore, Dhrupad in Telugu also means 'that which is fixed or established at the base or foundation'. This is the origin of the name in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Dhrupad
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhrupad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhrupad is a Sanskrit word derived from the roots ‘dhru’ meaning ‘established’ and ‘pad’ meaning ‘sound’. In Hindu mythology, Dhrupad is the name of a renowned singer in the court of Lord Krishna. He was known for his melodious voice and spiritual songs that moved the gods.
